# Week 10 Start/Sit — Monday briefing (2026-11-09)

**Week 9 is closed for this roster** (all nine of our players' games are done; only MIN@BUF Monday night remains league-wide, and nobody on this roster plays in it). This briefing looks ahead to **Week 10**.

## Source and freshness
Self-generated run (`generate_report.py`, sandbox network limits — no FantasyPros, ESPN, Sleeper, Rotowire or DynastyProcess crosswalk). Live nflreadpy schedules, player stats (through Week 9), depth charts and the fitted availability model all ran successfully. No Week 10 injury filings exist anywhere yet (teams start filing Wednesday) — every "Healthy" tag below means "nothing on record," not "cleared." The committed `weekly-report-week-10.json` fixture is still the 2026-09-08 pre-season placeholder, so this run supersedes it per the routine's fallback rule.

## Start these ten (Week 10, expected points = P(play) × if-he-plays)

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | If he plays | P(play) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Tyler Shough (NO) | vs CAR | **18.46** | 18.98 | 97.3% |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor (IND) | vs MIA | **15.34** | 16.00 | 95.9% |
| RB | Cam Skattebo (NYG) | vs WAS | **11.89** | 13.00 | 91.4% |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba (SEA) | vs LV | **21.27** | 21.87 | 97.2% |
| WR | Tee Higgins (CIN) | vs PIT | **15.62** | 16.08 | 97.1% |
| TE | Isaiah Likely (NYG) | vs WAS | **14.11** | 14.81 | 95.2% |
| FLEX | Drake London (ATL) | vs KC | **14.61** | 15.03 | 97.2% |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams (DET) | vs NE | **11.40** | 11.74 | 97.1% |
| K | Jake Bates (DET) | vs NE | **8.34** | 8.45 | 98.7% |
| DEF | Jets D/ST (NYJ) | vs BUF | **5.28** | 5.28 | 100% |

**Lineup total: 136.32 expected points** (sanity range 100-140 — passes).

**Bench:** Matthew Stafford (QB), Bucky Irving (RB, BYE), Bo Nix (QB, BYE), Sam LaPorta (TE), Jalen Coker (WR).

## Changes since the last briefing (Sat, Week 9)
- **Bucky Irving is on BYE.** His RB slot is forced open — Cam Skattebo is the only bench RB, so he starts by necessity, not confidence (see Watch list).
- **QB: Tyler Shough in for Matthew Stafford (+2.48 exp).** Same swap this model recommended two Mondays ago; Shough has scored 22, 24, and 19.7-pace production over his last starts and clears Stafford again this week.
- **TE: Isaiah Likely in for Sam LaPorta (+3.20 exp).** Likely has out-produced LaPorta in 3 of the last 4 weeks (16.3 pts in Week 9 on 5/6/53/1TD vs LaPorta's 7.2).
- **FLEX: Jameson Williams in for Jalen Coker (+1.22 exp).** Thin margin — recheck Wednesday/Friday practice reports before locking.

## Watch list
- **Cam Skattebo (hamstring).** Listed Doubtful heading into Week 9 (Limited practice, hamstring) and **did not record a single snap** — Devin Singletary took the Giants' workload instead (21 carries, a season high). No Week 10 designation exists yet because teams haven't filed. He is our only bench RB and is being started purely because Irving is on bye — **there is zero RB depth behind him on this roster.** Recheck nflreadpy's injury feed and Sleeper/ESPN (outside this sandbox) Wednesday and Thursday. If he's limited again, **a free-agent RB add before Wednesday's waiver deadline is the right move** — this tool can't see other teams' rosters to name a specific available target, but prioritize a standalone/committee back with real touches over a pure handcuff.
- Nobody else on this roster carries an open designation as of their last filed report (Stafford, Taylor, JSN all logged Full Participation in Week 9; Higgins' groin and London's limited-practice note both resolved weeks ago).

## Opponent notes
- **JSN vs LV** — Raiders are a soft matchup; JSN's 21.27 is the top projection on the roster this week.
- **Skattebo vs WAS** — if he's active, Washington's run defense isn't a reason to sit him; the hamstring is the only question.
- **Shough vs CAR** — Panthers' pass defense has been generous; supports the swap over Stafford.

## Byes ahead
- **Week 10 (this week):** Bucky Irving (RB, TB) — forced the RB swap above. Bo Nix (QB, DEN) — bench-only, no lineup impact.
- **Week 11 — the triple bye flagged in prior briefings: Matthew Stafford (QB, LAR), Jaxon Smith-Njigba (WR, SEA), and Drake London (WR, ATL) are all out the same week.** Good news on slot-filling: Irving returns from bye and both TEs (Likely/LaPorta) are available, so FLEX can be covered by RB/TE depth without a WR add — the real cost is pure point production (JSN + London project for ~36 combined this week alone), not an empty slot. Still worth a speculative WR add if a good one surfaces on waivers this week, since Higgins + Williams alone is thin at the position for that week.
- No roster player has a Week 12 bye. Jonathan Taylor (RB, IND) and the Jets D/ST are both on bye Week 13.

## Caveats
- Sandbox network limits apply: no FantasyPros consensus tier, no ESPN/Sleeper injury overlay, no snap share (DynastyProcess crosswalk blocked), no Rotowire red-zone data, no LLM news summaries. All numbers are the in-house estimate tier only.
- No live Week 10 injury designations exist anywhere yet — every player above reads "Healthy" by absence of information, not by confirmation. Recheck Wednesday.
- The first attempt at generating this week's numbers hit transient 504 gateway timeouts from nflverse's data CDN (on `load_teams()` and a historical stats file the availability model trains on). Both resolved on retry within a few minutes; had the first attempt been used, the report would have silently shipped conditional-on-playing numbers instead of true expected values. The run used here is the clean retry.
- Cam Skattebo's start is a necessity pick (only bench RB, Irving on bye), not a model-confidence pick — see Watch list.
